record.name: Asana
record.one_liner: A web and mobile work management platform designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate personal access tokens or configure OAuth in the developer console.
record.api_note: The API covers workspaces, projects, tasks, attachments, custom fields, portfolios, and audit logs.

evidence.quote: Our APIs are currently provided for free
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
